headline: Construction Project Coordinator
summary: Construction project coordinator with four years on residential and commercial builds in Negros Oriental. I plan and track schedules, keep drawings, RFIs and daily reports in Procore, and make sure safety requirements and material take-offs are ready before each phase. I work closely with engineers, foremen and suppliers.

experience.title: Construction Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate schedules, subcontractors and deliveries for a 48-unit housing project and two commercial buildings.
Manage drawings, RFIs, submittals and daily reports in Procore for the whole site team.
Prepare quantity take-offs for concrete and rebar with the site engineer before each pour.
Organise toolbox talks and keep safety permits and inspections on schedule.

experience.title: Draftsman and Site Assistant
bullets: Revised floor plans and details in AutoCAD from engineers' mark-ups.
Helped measure completed work for progress billing.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
